verdict.rationale: LibreOffice documents single-step CLI operations: headless --convert-to, batch print-to-file, and applying a macro when a file opens. There is no evidence of a built-in way to chain convert, optimize and deliver steps into one job or a watched-folder workflow. Macros, the UNO API and users running it in Docker are developer building blocks or user-side workarounds, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can chain steps (convert, then optimize, then deliver) into one job or watched workflow
